address: Place de l'Église, au bourg, Mézos, 40170, France
bio: In a village set deep within the Landes forest, this restaurant boasts a façade with the red shutters that are so emblematic of the region. A fragrant pergola covered in jasmine leads to a charming covered terrace with mismatched furniture. Inside, the atmosphere is that of a rustic-style country house. The chef, who has gained a wealth of experience from his travels, rustles up cuisine that very much captures the zeitgeist, infused with creative details. The entire menu changes every month....
